participation.context: Read the forme on the line, and did not start a play.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Was at the sheet. He had not yet spoken.
participation.name: Richard Field

relations.note: the sheet is his, and the reading is yours

story.body: You read the Life of Julius Caesar where it hung and copied no page. A turned letter was ringed in brown ink. You drafted no play from it.

relations.note: the sheet is his, and the reading is yours

title: Read the Life of Julius Caesar where it hung

participation.context: Left the picture to the sheets.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the press-room is his, and the sheets are the picture

story.body: The hanging paper, the arm, and the case are what the picture holds. You are not in it.

relations.note: the press-room is his, and the sheets are the picture

title: Left a picture of the hanging sheets and the bar

participation.context: Priced the sheets, named the error's fate, and asked for the Holinshed without getting a day.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Moved the talk off her floor, and refused a promise made only to fill a silence.
participation.name: Jacqueline Field

participation.context: Paid, promised nothing, and carried the sheets flat.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: fourteen shillings, and no day named for the chronicle
relations.quote: Fourteen shillings to you, unbound, and my Holinshed home by Whitsun.

story.body: You bought the unbound sheets, refused Whitsun, and took Theseus as lines that stay and not as a play. The chronicle's gap stayed his.

relations.note: fourteen shillings, and no day named for the chronicle
relations.quote: Fourteen shillings to you, unbound, and my Holinshed home by Whitsun.

title: Paid fourteen shillings for the unbound sheets

participation.context: Wrote the note and left both lives undrafted.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the sheets are bought, and the chronicle is still unpromised

story.body: You let Theseus stay as lines. You did not open a new play, and you did not give Field a day.

relations.note: the sheets are bought, and the chronicle is still unpromised
